description: This file declares the interface IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which defines virtual callback methods for handling various OCI container events, such as start, stop, failure, and state change, each accepting a container name and a JSON object with event data.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling OCI container events, providing virtual callback methods to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container starts, providing the container name and associated data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container stops, providing the container name and associated data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container encounters a failure, providing the container name and associated data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when the OCI container's state changes, providing the container name and associated data.
